scope: Complete pinned AgentDojo v1 important_instructions comparison; rates are upstream grader outcomes with explicit denominators.

original.memory_reference: benchmarks/cpu_results.json contains measured peak process working set

resumed.memory_reference: benchmarks/cpu_results.json contains measured peak process working set

hosts.note: Checkpoint 'environment' fields describe the host that created each checkpoint; wall clock is split by host and must not be pooled.

diagnostics.note: Tasks whose upstream utility grader passes when the agent makes no calls. Diagnostic only; not a benchmark configuration.

unreplaced_atomic_writes.note: Temporary checkpoint writes left when a replace failed. Each extra record was rerun from the checkpoint; differs_from_final lists any record whose grader outcome changed on rerun.

run.human_approval: record ask and stop; no automatic approval

subset.selection: first task in each of the four named suites, fixed before inference
subset.warning: Development subset does not establish full benchmark performance

checkpoint_environment.memory_reference: benchmarks/cpu_results.json contains measured peak process working set

attack_success.coverage: AgentDojo task goal graders; excludes MCP metadata poisoning and all untested attack families
